info.name: Sanad Backend
info.description: Coverage is synchronized with registered Express routes (105 route entries, including Admin notification aliases), plus root and health probes. Volunteer and Admin credentials/tokens are separate; set adminEmail/adminPassword only for an Admin created on the backend.

request.description: Public. Body must meet auth.validators: fullName >= 3, 14-digit nationalId starting 2/3, valid email, 10 to 15 digit phone, dateOfBirth YYYY-MM-DD and age 10 to 100, password >= 6 and matching confirmPassword. city and gender are optional; gender: MALE, FEMALE, PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY. Uses example variables; use a unique nationalId/email/phone. Expected 201: success, message, accessToken, refreshToken, user.

exec: pm.test("Response includes a successful accessToken", function () {

request.description: Public. Requires nationalId and password. Post-response script saves response.accessToken to collection variable token and response.refreshToken to refreshToken. Expected 200: success, message, accessToken, refreshToken, user.
Public. Requires a valid refreshToken from Login. Expected 200: success, message, accessToken, refreshToken, user.
Public; this endpoint revokes the session identified by refreshToken. Expected 200: success and message.
Requires Bearer token. Expected 200: success, message, user profile and stats.
Requires Bearer token. No request body is read by this endpoint. Expected 200: success and message.
Requires Bearer token. Expected 200: success, message, profile with volunteer, stats, recognition, leaderboard, achievements, certificates, missions and badges.
Requires Bearer token. Expected 200: success, message and recognition object.
Requires Bearer token. Optional query period accepts weekly, monthly or all (defaults to weekly). Expected 200: success, message and leaderboard.
Explicit opt-in. Set enabled=false to revoke consent and clear the stored volunteer location.
Updates own last-known location after explicit consent. Coordinates and accuracyMeters are validated.
Shows access log for the authenticated volunteer?s location.
Requires Bearer token. Expected 200: success, message and summary containing volunteer, stats, announcements, todayTasks and upcomingTasks.

Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page, limit (max 100), status (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ACTIVE/COMPLETED/CANCELLED), createdById, locationId, mine=true. Expected 200: success, message, pagination, campaigns[].

{
  "title": "Volunteer Outreach Campaign",

request.description: Requires Bearer token. Required title (>=3), description (>=10), startDate/endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, start <= end) and either locationId or location {name, latitude, longitude, city, area}. Optional status, coverImage, times and non-negative attendance/report values. Expected 201: success, message, campaign.
Requires Bearer token. Path campaignId is a positive integer. Optional query latitude and longitude must be supplied together. Expected 200: success, message and campaign.

Requires Bearer token and campaign ownership. Partial body may contain title, description, coverImage, dates/times, status, non-negative attendanceRadiusMeters/attendancePoints/reportPoints, or locationId/location (not both). Expected 200: success, message and campaign.

Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page, limit (max 100), campaignId, locationId, volunteerId, date, fromDate, toDate, status (OPEN/ASSIGNED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/CANCELLED), assignedToMe, mine, latitude and longitude (coordinates together). Expected 200: success, message, pagination, tasks[].

Requires Bearer token and ownership of campaignId. Required title (>=3), description (>=10), campaignId, date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional times, status, non-negative attendanceRadiusMeters, and locationId or location. If location omitted, campaign location is used. Date must be within campaign dates. Expected 201: success, message and task.
Requires Bearer token. Optional query latitude and longitude must be supplied together. Expected 200: success, message and task including assignments.

Requires Bearer token and campaign ownership. Partial body may contain title, description, date, startTime/endTime (nullable), status, attendanceRadiusMeters, locationId or location. Expected 200: success, message and task.
Requires Bearer token and campaign ownership. Expected 200: success, message and assignments[].

Requires Bearer token and campaign ownership. Body volunteerId (positive integer), optional status (ASSIGNED/CHECKED_IN/CHECKED_OUT/COMPLETED/CANCELLED). Expected 201: success, message and assignment.

Requires Bearer token; only task owner or assigned volunteer. Partial body supports status, checkInTime, checkOutTime (ISO date-time), and non-negative integer hoursWorked. This is a general assignment update, not a dedicated check-out route. Expected 200: success, message and assignment.

Requires Bearer token and an assignment to this task. Optional latitude and longitude must be supplied together. Replace coordinates with actual location when needed. Expected 200: success, message and attendance preview with location, assignment and canCheckIn/canSubmitReport.

Requires Bearer token and task assignment. Body requires latitude and longitude in valid ranges; the volunteer must be within the configured attendance radius. No separate check-out endpoint is registered. Expected 200: success, message, attendance and summary.

Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page, limit (max 100), campaignId, taskId, volunteerId, mine. Access is limited to own reports or reports for campaigns created by the caller. Expected 200: success, message, pagination, reports[].

Requires Bearer token. Body requires taskId; optional campaignId, notes (max 5000), voiceNote (max 2048), images (string URL array), rating (integer 1 to 5). Caller must be assigned to task or own its campaign; assigned volunteers must have checked in. Expected 201: success, message, report and summary.
Requires Bearer token and report access (own report or campaign owner). Expected 200: success, message and report.

Requires Bearer token and report ownership. Partial body supports notes (max 5000), voiceNote (max 2048), images (string URL array) and rating (integer 1 to 5); at least one valid field is required. Expected 200: success, message and report.
Admin-only paginated report review queue.
Admin-only. Awards configured points/hours and completes eligible assignment once.
Admin-only. A rejection reason between 3 and 1000 characters is required.
Admin-only chronological review/audit history for the report.
Requires Bearer token. Path taskId is a positive integer. Expected 200: success, message and mission with reward, steps, progress, assignment, report and permissions.

Requires Bearer token and reportable assignment. Body must include non-empty notes (max 500 characters) or images (max 5); optional rating is integer 1 to 5. images must be URL strings. Expected 201: success, message, summary, report and updated mission.
Returns approved upcoming missions ordered by Haversine distance. Radius is 1-50000m; coordinates are explicit, not inferred.
Admin-only. status is APPROVED, REJECTED, or CANCELLED. A pending mission may be approved/rejected; an approved mission may be cancelled.
Creates a pending join request for an approved, published, non-full mission. Duplicate active requests are rejected.
Cancels the authenticated volunteer pending join request.
Admin-only, paginated requests. Optional status: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED.
Admin-only; atomically creates assignment and approves the request if mission capacity remains.
Admin-only. Optional rejection reason (max 1000 characters) is included in the volunteer notification.

Requires Bearer token. JSON body image must be Base64 or a data:image/jpeg|jpg|png|webp;base64,... URL; max encoded length 3,000,000 chars. Requires server IMGBB_API_KEY. Expected 201: success, message and image {url, thumbnailUrl}. Replace the small sample with the image to upload.
Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page, limit (max 100), volunteerId, status (OPEN/RESPONDED/RESOLVED/CANCELLED), mine. Expected 200: success, message, pagination, requests[].
Requires Bearer token. Expected 200: success, message, activeRequest (object or null) and summary.
Requires Bearer token. Query latitude and longitude are required; radiusKm is optional, defaults to 10 and is capped at 100. Expected 200: success, message, radiusKm and requests[].
Requires Bearer token. No body is read; caller must have an active request. Expected 200: success, message and request.

exec: pm.test("HTTP status is expected (200 or 201)", function () {

request.description: Requires Bearer token. Body requires latitude and longitude. Returns 201 for a new request or 200 when refreshing an existing active request. Expected: success, message, request and created.
Requires Bearer token. Path requestId is a positive integer. Expected 200: success, message and request.
Requires Bearer token and ownership of an active request. Body requires latitude and longitude. Expected 200: success, message and request.
Requires Bearer token. No body is read; caller must not be the requester and request must be active. Expected 200: success, message and request.
Requires Bearer token. Body status must be OPEN, RESPONDED, RESOLVED or CANCELLED; authorization depends on status and ownership. Expected 200: success, message and request.
Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page and limit (max 100). Expected 200: success, message, featuredAnnouncement, pagination and posts[].
Alias of GET /community. Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page and limit (max 100). Expected 200: success, message, featuredAnnouncement, pagination and posts[].
Requires Bearer token. Body content is required (3 to 5000 chars); optional image URL max 2048 chars. Expected 201: success, message and post.
Requires Bearer token; caller must own the post (or be demo admin). No body. Expected 200: success, message and deletedPostId.
Requires Bearer token. No request body; toggles the caller?s like. Expected 200: success, message and post.
Requires Bearer token. Path postId is a positive integer. Expected 200: success, message and comments[].
Requires Bearer token. Body content is required (1?2000 chars). Expected 201: success, message and comment.
Requires Bearer token. Optional query: page, limit (max 100), pinnedOnly boolean, sortBy=CREATEDAT. Expected 200: success, message, pagination and announcements[].
Requires Bearer token. Body title (3 to 200 chars), content (5 to 5000 chars), optional image URL (max 2048), optional isPinned boolean. Expected 201: success, message and announcement.
Public. Root route returns service status and docs links. Expected 200: success, message and docs.
Public. Expected 200 when database/schema are ready: success, message and data {release,timestamp,database,schema}; returns 503 when database or schema is unavailable.

Requires Bearer token. Body messages is a history array of {role: user|assistant, content: non-empty string}; last usable message must be from user. Requires GROQ_API_KEY. Expected 200: success and reply string.
Requires Bearer token. Expected 200: success and overview data.
Requires Bearer token. No body is read. This endpoint changes demo database records; use only in an authorized test environment. Expected 200: success and seed result.
Requires Bearer token. No body is read. Deletes demo community posts; use only in an authorized test environment. Expected 200: success and cleanup result.
Use an account created by npm run admin:bootstrap or POST /admin/accounts. Saves accessToken to adminToken and refreshToken to adminRefreshToken. Requires a separate Admin identity.
Rotates the separate admin refresh session and updates adminToken/adminRefreshToken.
Revokes the admin refresh session.
Requires Admin Bearer token. New password must be 12-128 characters; currentPassword is required.
Admin-only dashboard counters for volunteers, campaigns, tasks, pending join requests/reports, totals and emergency incidents.
Admin-only, paginated account list. Optional search filters name/email.
Creates another ADMIN account; password must be 12-128 characters. Never use a volunteer token.
Only fullName, email, and isActive are accepted. Disabling an account revokes its active sessions.
Admin-only reset for another admin; revokes that account sessions and requires password change.
Admin-only directory. Optional filters: search, status, activity (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), titleLevel (1-5). Does not expose credentials.
Admin-only volunteer detail and records; excludes passwords, refresh tokens, and auth sessions.
Admin-only, audited access. reason is mandatory. Locations are only available for consented active missions or active incidents; stale fixes are not live.
Admin-only, audited access. reason is mandatory; only retained updates associated with active authorized work are returned.
Admin-only, paginated audit history. Optional filters: action, targetType, targetId.
Admin-only in-app notification inbox.
Admin-only unread in-app notification count.
Marks an owned admin notification as read.
Marks all notifications owned by the authenticated admin as read.
Deletes only a notification owned by the authenticated admin.
Admin-only FCM device registration. Supply a real FCM token and platform android, ios, or web.
Deactivates only a device token owned by the authenticated admin.
Admin-only incident dashboard. Optional filters include status and volunteerId; location access is rate-limited and audited.
Admin-only incident details, volunteer contact fields allowed by policy, mission and map coordinates.
Admin-only, paginated location updates for an incident; updates stop being accepted after the incident closes.
Statuses: ACKNOWLEDGED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, CANCELLED, FALSE_ALARM. Notes are required for terminal closure/cancellation/false alarm.
Cron-only. Authorization must be Bearer {{cronSecret}}. Deletes expired location history and clears expired SOS coordinates.

Requires volunteer Bearer token. GPS coordinates, accuracy (0-1000), and recent deviceTimestamp are required; missionId/message are optional. A supplied mission must be an approved active assignment. Rate-limited; one active incident per volunteer.
Returns the authenticated volunteer active incident, if one exists.
Requires owner volunteer token and an active incident. Older-than-five-minute locations and updates after closure are rejected.
Only the reporting volunteer can cancel their active incident; reason is required.
Requires explicit location-sharing opt-in and an approved active assignment during the mission time window. deviceTimestamp must be recent.
Authenticated account inbox with pagination.
Unread count for the authenticated account only.
Marks an owned notification as read; other users notifications are not accessible.
Marks all notifications belonging to the authenticated account as read.
Deletes only a notification owned by the authenticated account.
Registers/updates an owned device. Supply an actual FCM token; platform is android, ios, or web.
Deactivates only the authenticated account device token.
Cron-only. Authorization must be Bearer {{cronSecret}}. Event keys prevent duplicate reminder notifications.
